text: Deferred income tax liabilities increased due to temporary differences in depreciation.
The effective tax rate was 21.4 percent, compared with 23.1 percent in the prior year.
The independent auditor issued an unqualified opinion on the consolidated financial statements.
Management identified a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting.
The master services agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless terminated.
The lease obligates the company to minimum annual payments through 2031.
A putative class action was filed against the company in the Northern District of California.
The court granted the motion to dismiss and the plaintiffs have appealed the ruling.
